descriptor: App that turns prompts into cinematic scenes

voice.summary: Kova sounds like an enthusiastic creative partner who wants to see your idea on screen. It speaks in simple, vivid verbs and keeps instructions as short as a prompt.
dos: Use vivid verbs: pick, drop, render
Keep onboarding copy to two short lines
donts: Do not use heavy AI jargon
Avoid grand claims about replacing artists

taglines: Turn your ideas into cinematic scenes
Pick a style. Drop a prompt
Direct the movie in your pocket
boilerplate: Kova is a creative app that turns written prompts into cinematic scenes in your chosen style, rendered on your phone in moments.

microcopy.error: The render did not finish. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No scenes yet. Drop a prompt to begin.

logo.note: A camera aperture suits an app that frames and renders cinematic scenes.
